main_text.p: id genus, quæ Natura voluit suorum miraculorū acervos, illices & exploratores esse. Intelligentia jam à scientiis cultâ, ab Experientiis firmâ ac maturâ, Hypothesis Physica proponatur, quæ Sensum cum Ratione, Experimenta cum Scientiis ad amussim conciliet. Tandem agmen hoc claudat Ethica

Eja Amor sapientiæ, in sublime te tolle: defere nos hîc tantisper cum plebe, æternum equidem tibi jurejurando devinctos: Incesse summorum Magistratuum & Principum Virorum pectora: opus est eorum robusto brachio, ut Genus Humanum in futi-

page.notes: Marginal fragments at the right edge belong to the facing page and are not transcribed. Catchword "futi-" is a word-break at the foot of the text, taken as catchword; the text line above it already ends with "in".
